ideas.title: Uncovering the scope of Minnesota's fraud problem
ideas.description: Investigate the breadth of fraud schemes in Minnesota, focusing on connections between entities and programs.
questions: What are the common patterns among Minnesota fraud schemes?
How do these schemes impact the state's economy?
ideas.insight: The $250 million Feeding Our Future scheme highlights a significant issue with fraud in Minnesota, warranting further investigation into potential connections with other entities and programs.
